subject: Req: BCP artifacts + short witness window for RTO/RPO evidence
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@speedlinepay.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: BCP evidence + short witness window for RTO/RPO

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We have a SOC 2 + SIG intake that flagged a few follow-ups on BCP/DR. Security is requesting: a concise packet showing observed RTO and RPO samples for the last four restore drills, plus any warm-standby activation logs and a short window where we can witness a run (even tabletop).

High-level asks: 1) RTO/RPO timestamped samples (CSV or similar) 2) Warm-standby activation trace for at least one drill 3) Answers to the SIG BCP section (we only need the BCP part) 4) A 30–45 minute window next week for a remote witness.

Can you confirm what you can provide and a suggested witness time? We are aiming to close this doc by EOD 3/20.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Security Program Manager
SpeedlinePay

Attachments: none
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@speedlinepay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BCP evidence + short witness window for RTO/RPO

Samira — thanks for the clear list. We can give you a compact evidence pack and a live tabletop walk-through. Quick confirmations before we pull artifacts:

- Do you need full telemetry for all four drills or representative samples (we usually provide full timestamps for one drill and sampled traces for the others)?
- Is the witness session a live activation run or a guided table-top with recorded traces? We can do either; live activation may require a scheduled ops blackout window.

Proposed: we upload a packet today with a full CSV for the March 2 drill and sampled rows for the previous three. We’ll include warm-standby activation logs (anonymized) and a completed SIG BCP section PDF. For witness, how does Tue 3/14 11:00–11:45 PT look? If you need evenings ET, we can shift.

I’ll route artifacts to your Drive link and put the high-level answer doc in-line.

—Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments (incoming): rto-rpo-timestamp-samples.csv (stub), warm-standby-activation-log.txt (stub), sig-answers-bcp-section.pdf (stub)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@speedlinepay.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@speedlinepay.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 12:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BCP evidence + short witness window for RTO/RPO

Karthik — representative samples are fine for the three older drills. Full trace for one is preferred. For the witness, Tue 3/14 11:00 PT works for our team. Can you also include a short single-page narrative describing the drill scope and the failover criteria used (RTO goal, what triggered the failover, who executed it)? That helps our reviewers.

Liam
Head of Infrastructure Security
SpeedlinePay
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@speedlinepay.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@speedlinepay.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Mar 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BCP evidence + short witness window for RTO/RPO

Samira / Liam — uploading the artifacts to the Drive link now. Contents:
- rto-rpo-timestamp-samples.csv: full drill (2028-03-02) + sampled rows for 2027-11-10, 2027-08-15, 2027-05-06. Columns: event_ts, event_type, initiating_actor, kv_cache_state, observed_latency_s.
- warm-standby-activation-log.txt: sanitized operator commands and timestamps for the March activation; no secrets.
- sig-answers-bcp-section.pdf: completed SIG BCP section, called out owner contacts and retention windows.
- one-pager: drill-summary-3mar2028.pdf (short narrative per Liam's ask).

Notes on redaction: we've removed internal hostnames and replaced exact IPs with region tags; timestamps are real. If you need raw logs for audit, we can provide them under an NDA channel.

Confirming witness: Tue 2028-03-14 11:00–11:45 PT (11:00 Zoom invite sent). Agenda: 5m intros / scope, 20m drill walkthrough, 15m Q&A. Invite includes ops and SRE contacts.

—Priyom
Engineering Programs, Redwood Inference

Attachments uploaded: rto-rpo-timestamp-samples.csv, warm-standby-activation-log.txt, sig-answers-bcp-section.pdf, drill-summary-3mar2028.pdf
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@speedlinepay.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Mar 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BCP evidence + short witness window for RTO/RPO

Thanks — I reviewed the Drive folder and the one-pager looks great. The CSV has the columns we requested. We’ll review the artifacts and plan to attend the Tue session. Two small follow-ups: 1) can you add a line to the one-pager noting the data retention policy that affected how long you retain warm-standby traces, and 2) please confirm there are no customer PII fields in any logs (we saw none in the samples but want an explicit attestation).

If you can drop a brief note in the folder answering those two items before the session, we should be able to mark our SIG intake as complete.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Samira
